resources.string: Recognition and translation run on this device — no Google services. Internet is only used to download language packs.
Share any image to TextGrab, or add the \"OCR screenshot\" tile to quick settings: take a screenshot, tap the tile, select the text.
Downloading language models (about 30 MB per language, only once)…

Lets the OCR screenshot tile capture the screen by itself, so one tap on the tile is enough. TextGrab only takes a screenshot when you tap the tile. It does not read screen content, does not observe your input and has no internet access.
Screen capture failed, opening latest screenshot instead
No text found in this image
Photo access is needed to open your latest screenshot
Select, copy and translate text from any image
Capture the screen with a single tap on the tile
Grab text with the assistant gesture
Each pack is about 30 MB and works offline once installed. Tap a language to translate into it.
Choose what does the translating. The built-in engine runs on this device; the others send the recognized text to a service you configure with your own API key.
Free, private, works offline. Translates sentence by sentence.
Natural wording, strong on European languages. Needs a DeepL API key.
The widest language coverage. Needs a Google Cloud API key.
Translates the whole screen at once, so wording stays consistent. OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Groq, Mistral, Together, a local Ollama or LM Studio — or any other endpoint you type in.
Translates the whole screen at once; good with interface wording and short labels.
Text you translate leaves this device and is sent to the service above.
%1$s needs an API key. Set it up under Translation engine.
Create a key at deepl.com/pro-api — the free tier allows 500,000 characters a month. Free keys end in “:fx”.
Enable the Cloud Translation API in Google Cloud and create an API key. Billed per character.
Works with any service that speaks OpenAI\'s /chat/completions API. Tap a preset, or type your own endpoint and model name. A server running on this device (Ollama, LM Studio) needs no key.
Create a key at console.anthropic.com. A small, fast model is plenty for translation.
